summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed on a synthetic checkpoint, with a corrected probe. At 875e503e84dd and the fix parent f45eb4ce2090, use_qk_norm true built no Q/K norm modules and logits equalled the option-off run exactly. At the fix 91c7cc41881c the option built 4 norm modules for 2 layers, the option-off run built none, and logits differed by up to about 0.083. This attempt supersedes the diagnostic in attempt 001, whose has_q_norm line printed False at every commit because it inspected only top-level modules; the logit comparison in 001 was sound.
what_ran: repro.py generates a 2-layer random CohereForCausalLM checkpoint (hidden size 256, 4 heads) in two directories differing only in use_qk_norm, loads each with unmodified Config.from_directory and Model.from_config on GPU 1, lists Q/K norm modules by iterating the model, and compares Model.forward logits for one 24-token random input.
limits: The checkpoint is random and generated by the script; no real Command-R+ weights were used, because they exceed this worker's size limit. The test shows the option is ignored before the fix and takes effect after it, not that the fixed normalization matches a reference implementation. Unquantized weights only.
